title: Tennessee Bound
niche: data-driven Tennessee relocation analysis for retirees — town-by-town property tax, hospital access, insurance, flood risk, cost of living
narrator_persona: a calm, knowledgeable guide who speaks directly to camera a few times; mostly voiceover narration with b-roll
scene_style: Tennessee small-town Main Streets, rolling farmland, modest suburban homes, county courthouses, hospital exteriors, lakefront properties — documentary, not tourism-board pretty
style_suffix: candid documentary snapshot, soft natural light, muted earthy colors, mostly in focus, mundane and plain, photorealistic, not cinematic, not glossy
script_notes: No hype, no clickbait. Every claim backed by a named source (Comptroller, FEMA, State Data Center). Speak to a 55-65 year old considering Tennessee retirement.
